historical_availability: The dataset has a Tuesday report date but does not expose original dissemination timestamps in each row. The app records first-seen time and does not backdate availability; do not use rows in backtests before first-seen time.
limitations: COT reports futures positioning, not ETF holdings or direct fund flows; linked ETFs are economic proxies only.
Tuesday positions are normally released Friday at 3:30 p.m. Eastern, with holiday delays; app first-seen time is the only availability timestamp used.
Disaggregated classifications are not historical point-in-time trader identities and can be revised or suppressed.
Aluminum is an LME contract and may not be an investable IB product; it is a reference indicator only.
These features are research-only and cannot add an ETF to an eligible strategy universe.
